title: 第九章 李晴川第十章 扔到山下喂野狗
lines: 苍元界，有九州之地，大夏独占五州，修行之风极盛。
赤州是五大州域最弱的一个，共有八个宗门，太玄宗坐落在云川一带的核心，一直以来都至高无上，是绝对的主宰。
太玄山，方圆百里，仙雾缭绕，天地元气充沛。
两个身影行了三天路，此刻终于出现在太玄山脚下。
抬头仰望，苍松碧石，殿堂林立，一座巍峨山门耸立，大气磅礴。
“修行圣地，超然世外啊。”
林昊感叹道。
“大夏上千年的传承，据说大夏的开朝始祖，是太玄宗的一代天骄，太玄宗也辉煌鼎盛过，可惜，时代更迭，如今……哎！”
黄良重重一叹，一个传承久远的宗门，如今却要被废除了，身为太玄宗弟子，这份伤感，实在是由内而发。
“走吧，上山，听说想干我的人排成队，我看看怎么个事。”
林昊迈开大长腿，一跃三五丈，直奔山门而去。
黄良身后紧随，脸上满是担忧，更是忍不住出言提醒：“昊哥，咱还是低调点。”
“我倒是想低调，那些排队的人能让我低调吗？”
林昊嗤之以鼻。
低调？
窝囊的人才低调。
排队？谁干谁还不好说。
他身份特殊，如今身处漩涡中，不挣扎就是死。
从踏出天宝城的那一刻，他就没打算低调。
黄良没有说话，却是忧心忡忡，脸上写满担忧。
林昊看出黄良心思，伸手拍了拍黄良肩膀，道：“黄良，我不知道林家对你做了什么，让你对我毕恭毕敬，如今已经到了太玄宗，你无需再顾忌其他，一会踏入太玄宗，你就全当不认识我，咱俩一路同行，也算是缘分一场，我不会针对你，也不想牵连你，你走吧。”
言罢，林昊大步前行，横跨太玄宗山门，走了进去。
后方，黄良脸色几经变幻，然后咬了咬牙：“昊哥，等等我。”
林昊的话让黄良心生感动，算是真正为自己考虑。
但，他黄良受李晴川指派前往天宝城杀林昊，如今任务失败归来，半路上还眼睁睁看着林昊杀了三个同门，此刻又亲自带着林昊上山门。
黄良心里很清楚，从他接受李晴川指派的任务，前往天宝城的那一刻，他就已经深陷漩涡之中，此刻想抽身而去，根本不可能。
“怎么？你不怕李晴川？”
林昊问道。
“怕？我黄良只是一个小角色，跟谁都斗不过，但我不傻，只要你活着出现在太玄宗，我就不可能扯清关系，我现在唯一能做的，只能站队。”
黄良郑重说道。
“所以呢？”
content_en:
In Cangyuan Realm, there are nine states. Daxia exclusively occupies five states, and the practice of cultivation is extremely popular.
Chizhou is the weakest of the five major states, with a total of eight sects. Taixuan Sect is located at the core of the Yunchuan area. It has always been supreme and the absolute master.
Taixuan Mountain, with a radius of hundreds of miles, is surrounded by fairy mist and full of vitality.
The two figures walked for three days and finally appeared at the foot of Taixuan Mountain.
Looking up, you will see green pines and blue rocks, numerous palaces, and a majestic mountain gate.
"The Holy Land of Cultivation is aloof from the world."
Lin Hao sighed.
"The inheritance of Daxia has lasted for thousands of years. It is said that the founding ancestor of Daxia was a generation of geniuses of Taixuanzong. Taixuanzong also flourished in its glory. Unfortunately, times have changed, and now... ugh!"
Huang Liang sighed heavily. A sect with a long tradition was now about to be abolished. As a disciple of Taixuan Sect, this sadness really came from within.
"Let's go up the mountain. I heard that people who want to fuck me are lining up. Let me see what happens."
Lin Hao stretched out his long legs, jumped three to five feet, and headed straight for the mountain gate.
Huang Liang followed closely behind him, his face full of worry, and he couldn't help but remind him: "Brother Hao, let's keep a low profile."
"I want to keep a low profile. Can those people in line allow me to keep a low profile?"
Lin Hao sneered.
Low profile?
A coward keeps a low profile.
queue? It’s hard to say who will do who.
He has a special status, and now he is in a whirlpool. If he doesn't struggle, he will die.
From the moment he stepped out of Tianbao City, he had no intention of keeping a low profile.
Huang Liang didn't speak, but he was worried, with worry written on his face.
Lin Hao saw Huang Liang's thoughts, reached out and patted Huang Liang's shoulder, and said: "Huang Liang, I don't know what the Lin family did to you to make you treat me with respect. Now that you have arrived at Taixuan Sect, you don't need to worry about anything else. Once you step into Taixuan Sect, you will pretend you don't know me. We are traveling together this way, and it is fate. I will not target you, and I don't want to implicate you. You go."
After saying this, Lin Hao strode forward, crossed the Taixuanzong Mountain Gate, and walked in.
Behind him, Huang Liang's expression changed several times, and then he gritted his teeth: "Brother Hao, wait for me."
Lin Hao's words moved Huang Liangliang, and he truly considered himself.
However, he, Huang Liang, was assigned by Li Qingchuan to go to Tianbao City to kill Lin Hao. Now that the mission failed and he returned, he watched Lin Hao kill three of his fellow disciples on the way, and now he personally took Lin Hao to the mountain gate.
Huang Liangliang knew very well that from the moment he accepted the mission assigned by Li Qingchuan and went to Tianbao City, he had been deeply involved in the whirlpool. It was impossible to escape at this moment.
"What? Aren't you afraid of Li Qingchuan?"
Lin Hao asked.
"Afraid? I, Huang Liang, am just a small character. I can't fight anyone. But I'm not stupid. As long as you appear in Taixuanzong alive, I won't be able to clear up the relationship. The only thing I can do now is to stand in line."
Huang Liang said solemnly.
"so what?"
title_en: Chapter 9 Li Qingchuan Chapter 10 Throwing it down the mountain to feed wild dogs
